svg.title: Finals settings and rights (organiser, event admin)
svg.text: 16 · Finals settings and rights (organiser, event admin)
Use case: the event admin connects the event to a Finals app and sets the platform's few settings (0030). The left settings and the crew role are the legacy app's own, shown as the record: dropped

g.text: Each player always sees their own

Ping the crew when a dispute waits
Per event. No address set: Finals is off here
The secret is stored encrypted and never shown again.
The host runs the app: its own server or beside the platform.

svg.text: Controls drop under their labels; nothing is typed.
The page scrolls to the crew pings and names.
Defaults are the legacy's: ranking changes shown, six votes, the two card windows of 15 and 10 minutes; public start becomes 'members may start', off (U12, O4).
The connection (address, write-only secret, test) is the platform's; the event admin's existing settings right covers it (O5).
